Metric type constants, metadata struct, and helper macros for gauge, counter, and histogram metrics.

# Purpose
This header defines the shared metadata format used by the metrics system. It declares constants for metric types and value converters, plus helper macros that build `fd_metrics_meta_t` entries from generated metric names, descriptions, offsets, and histogram limits. The `fd_metrics_meta_t` structure stores the fields needed to describe one metric, including optional histogram bounds and enum-related data for indexed metrics. It also provides the inline function [`fd_metrics_meta_type_str`](<#fd_metrics_meta_type_str>) to convert a metric type value into a text label such as `gauge`, `counter`, or `histogram`.
